cross_case_findings.central_role_allocation: Both independent-reader cases failed on unresolved-meaning leakage. Both paired-reader cases allocated the shared meaning correctly.
cross_case_findings.protected_qualification_survival: The protected qualification survived in all four cases; the current problem is no longer basic qualification omission on this corpus.
cross_case_findings.speaker_ownership: Material user-versus-assistant ownership survived in all four source reviews, although component expression labels remain imperfect.
cross_case_findings.evidence_precision: Every architecture showed some overinclusive contextual or assistant-summary evidence.
cross_case_findings.expression_force: Force remains uneven across architectures; pairing fixed allocation but did not remove modal-label noise.
cross_case_findings.object_category_precision: Coarse object categories remain persistent and were not solved by pairing.
cross_case_findings.relationship_preservation: Independent relationships were partial, v2.4 was blocked before relation, and v2.4.1 produced the first paired relationship pass.

decision.reason: Paired allocation has passed twice on distinct shared-meaning cases. The larger unknown is now whether persistent evidence, force, and category imprecision materially changes downstream mental-model selection or pressure, which another similar extraction call would not answer.
decision.shadow_scope: Compare source-first target records with preserved model records on v2.4 and v2.4.1 through a read-only, no-reconsideration, no-runtime graph-input and selection-impact shadow.

limitations: Four synthetic prospective cases are not independent human validation.
Architecture and case domain change together, so the comparison is directional rather than causal proof.
V2.4 relationship preservation is unobserved because the status contradiction correctly blocked the relation call.
No automatic semantic judge or scalar quality score was used.
No product utility or better-final-answer claim follows from this corpus review.
